answer: Farming becomes a basalt bet on surviving 86 epochs of grading, and every wander settlement recomputes the kernel schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 86 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
